# Company operational evidence replay — wave158

Baseline: `3f14ec4a`. Assigned branch `codex/wave158-company-operations`. Node `22.22.1` explicitly selected from `/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin`. No repository changes, no PR, no production writes, no financial-judgment enablement.

## Real EDGAR workflow

Fetched anonymously and preserved the unmodified live response:
`https://www.osbornalpha.com/api/companies/AAPL/facts?concept=revenue&periodStart=2023-10-01&periodEnd=2024-09-28&unit=USD`.

The response contains three `kind: fact` entries. Downloaded original bytes using its stable `/api/companies/snapshot?fact=b99454eb-ab9f-4726-8989-e3752972e72a` link. Downloaded SEC's public companyfacts endpoint separately, with a descriptive user agent: `https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/companyfacts/CIK0000320193.json`. Both HTTP 200, 3,859,564 bytes, identical SHA256 `f085735b4d08fb116ade18d24247ffabe11df8eb52eae6556b165831f15ef1ad`. Signed redirect credentials were not recorded or printed.

Ran the documented CLI against the original API JSON and downloaded snapshot for all three real fact IDs. Each exited 0 with `source_replay_verified`, value `391035000000`, mapping `facts-map/1`. Fact IDs and complete outputs are in `replay-matrix.json`.

23 operational cases: 3 real positive runs, 17 modified-input rejection runs (all exit 1 with bounded reason), 3 invalid input/usage runs (exit 2). Tested byte tampering; truncated response; withheld, duplicate, missing fact; missing evidence; unsupported mapping; incorrect value/pointer/hash locator/run/filing/period/concept/unit; absent code version; CN; invalid JSON; missing file; missing arguments. Modified inputs are adversarial probes, not public evidence. Missing-file and invalid-JSON stderr omits file paths/content.

65 existing tests passed across replay, evidence gate, evidence index. `baseline-tests.log` preserves the command output. No confirmed functional replay problem found. This is consistency under the current landed parser, not authentication of saved metadata, historical code behavior, claimed asOf availability, complete disclosure history, or human gold acceptance. A user can rewrite unauthenticated metadata coherently; that is explicitly outside this command's documented claim.

## Actual CN public sample and capability boundary

Downloaded official CNInfo PDF: `https://static.cninfo.com.cn/finalpage/2025-03-29/1222946269.PDF` (Hengsheng Electronics, 600570, 2024 annual report), HTTP 200, 4,552,771 bytes, SHA256 `771c7cfe4d8c133991af831eeebb99d14bffdfb0ed8b55e1c091d5eba8fd5eff`.

Ran existing `extractPdf` and `detectTables` against actual bytes. Shared root dependencies lacked pdfjs-dist; downloaded pinned `pdfjs-dist@4.10.38` package into task scratch and injected its loader/CMap/font paths using existing extraction options, without changing root checkout dependencies. Text extraction succeeded on all 222 physical pages; logged rendering-polyfill warnings did not prevent text extraction. This was text/table extraction, not rendered visual or human acceptance.

Physical page 72 has `合并利润表`, `2024年1—12月`, CNY yuan unit, 2024/2023 columns. Both total revenue and operating revenue are `6,581,075,306.06`; two distinct row/cell locations share the value. Page 74 starts the parent-company income statement with revenue `5,329,948,899.18`. Existing tables expose text, page, row/column, and offsets; they do not reconcile a published Tushare fact identity to those cells. Raw extraction is necessary but insufficient for `PdfLocatorSource`.

Production `src/lib/company/deps.ts` still wires `emptyPdfLocatorSource`. `pdf-locator.ts` explicitly defers real locators to upstream reconciliation. Static locators are tests/injected acceptance fixtures only. `pair-cn-gold.ts` consumes reviewed gold rather than producing arbitrary live per-fact locators. `docs/runbooks/cn-gold-transcription.md` requires independent recorder/reviewer and a same-version Tushare source reference; the gold source/row/column/page also need binding to the specific stored fact, exact PDF, and current extraction. No verified Tushare fact IDs or recorder/reviewer decisions were available for this sample. Did not manufacture locators.

Concrete prerequisites for the next implementation:
1. Assign R1 recorder and R2 independent reviewer; complete same-version gold with PDF SHA, source reference, concept, printed unit/precision, physical page, row and column.
2. Settle the persistence/read contract joining verified per-value reconciliation to fact ID, issuer, filing/source version, PDF URL/hash, extraction version and current raw/value identity, including invalidation on reimport/revision/re-extraction and conflict abstention. The current `locate(issuerId,market,factIds)` interface alone specifies no producer/storage/invalidation behavior.
3. Implement the upstream source with real accepted evidence and tests for duplicate equal values, total vs operating revenue, consolidated vs parent tables, comparison years, unit scale, missing text, stale versions, mismatch/ambiguity.
4. Keep production CN values withheld until that real source is wired and acceptance passes. Complete the separate human gold matrix before claiming full company acceptance.

## MiniMax audit

Real `MiniMax-M2.5` final audit completed with `stop_reason=end_turn` (`mmx-final.json`, extracted `mmx-final.txt`). Verdict: CN withholding justified; no confirmed US replay bug; consistency wording required. Its request did not include the independently observed two-file SHA comparison or complete gate/CLI source, so its cautions about those missing inputs do not override the execution record. Focused closure audit also completed with `stop_reason=end_turn` (`mmx-closure.json` / `mmx-closure.txt`), after supplying direct-SEC byte identity, gate/CLI source, and cutoff 1900. Earlier network failure, timeout, and short max_tokens response are preserved but do not count as approval.

- `facts-response.json`: actual saved production API JSON.
- `snapshot.json`, `CIK0000320193.json`: exact archived/direct public source bytes.
- `replay-matrix.mjs`, `replay-matrix.json`: rerunnable CLI operational checks and results.
- `baseline-tests.log`: 65 passing repository tests.
- `600570-2024.pdf`, `cn-pages.json`, `cn-assessment.json`, `extract-cn.mjs`, `cn-extraction.log`: actual PDF, extraction and source assessment.
- `evidence-summary.json`: compact machine-readable summary.

# Industry valuation readiness — wave release158

Date: 2026-11-07. Assigned checkout: `wave158-industry-readiness`, branch `codex/wave158-industry-readiness`, inspected HEAD `3f14ec4a075f8bc200681929e887ceff92892d5e`. Independent Codex CLI session; no additional agents/CLI sessions spawned. This report is a readiness assessment, not release approval.

## Outcome

No remaining bounded **real I-3 implementation slice** was found that can proceed under an already approved methodology. H remains unselected in specification §6.4/§16 and the runbook; PB remains unverified. Consequently no formula, policy, schema, job, license, flag, publication or production changes were made, and no commit/push/PR is proposed. This follows the task's report fallback rather than repeating #147's disabled preparation or #154's arithmetic fix. The existing runbook already requires independent dataset authorization, so this evidence is retained in the task report rather than opening a redundant audit-only PR.

Reviewed: industry specification §6.1–6.5, §13.4 and §16; runbook §2/4/5; K1–K3 verification record; industry closeout; `VALUATION-PREPARATION.md`; provider, ingestion, preparation, diagnostics, jobs and public input boundaries; the #154 forward migration. This does not audit unrelated release work.

Current code supplies paged provider adapters, complete calendar validation, internal observation plans, membership/mark preparation and aligned numeric diagnostics. Actual approved formula computation, valuation manifests/replay, ingestion job orchestration, carry/dependency handling, publication/activation and percentiles are still absent. Existing SQL infrastructure does not confer method approval. `stage_industry_valuation_pairs` still maps both PE metrics to official PE; H must resolve basis-specific `not_applicable` semantics before any integration. #154's exact comparison was not changed or reimplemented.

## Primary-source provider and rights research

Checked current public documentation on 2026-11-07; no authenticated market fetch or provider contact was performed. Public pages describe offered services, not an executed entitlement or a rights decision for OsbornAlpha. Captured HTML bytes, retrieval times and hashes are in `provider-evidence.json`; these are page fingerprints, not proof of a contract or account entitlement.

| Candidate | Direct evidence | What remains unresolved / alternative |
|---|---|---|
| Tushare: existing implementation path | [sw_daily documentation](https://tushare.pro/document/2?doc_id=327) states SW2021 default, 4000 rows/request, 5000 points, trading-day 18:30 update; exposes PE, PB and market values. [daily_basic](https://tushare.pro/document/2?doc_id=32) documents share units in ten-thousands and `free_share`; access at 2000 points, 5000 without total limit. | Owner C must verify actual account entitlement, historical span, completeness, revisions and backfill cost. Field names do not specify the full SW comparator methodology. Tushare free shares are not established as identical to SW free shares. |
| Tushare: rights route | [Service agreement §II(2).5](https://tushare.pro/document/1?doc_id=405) describes a personal, nontransferable, noncommercial, revocable, time-limited, nonexclusive grant for personal viewing. [Custom services](https://tushare.pro/document/1?doc_id=12) offers bespoke data discussions; published contact is `waditu_a`. | Request written scope for organizational processing/storage, derivation, display, redistribution/replay, historical retention and upstream SW rights. This is a candidate negotiation route, not evidence that a commercial license exists or can be obtained. A standard points purchase alone is not evidence of the product rights needed here. |
| Tushare: scheme/calendar | [index_classify](https://tushare.pro/document/2?doc_id=181) and [index_member_all](https://tushare.pro/document/2?doc_id=335) require 2000 points. [trade_cal](https://tushare.pro/document/2?doc_id=26) requires 2000 points and exposes explicit exchange/open-day fields. | Public API descriptions do not replace historical availability evidence, membership reconstruction labeling or calendar completeness. The classify note says indices with fewer than 5 members are not published; this is not approval of a valuation sample rule or resolution of the old document's ≤5 rule. |
| Direct SW research / methodology confirmation | Existing K1 record identifies [2012 PE/PB method PDF](https://www.swsresearch.com/swindex/pdf/swclassifypepb.pdf) and [index method 5.0](https://www.swsresearch.com/swindex/pdf/80100350.pdf). Official index site is [SW index release](https://www.swsresearch.com/institute_sw/allIndex/releasedIndex). | This session could not freshly authenticate those PDFs: web fetch failed and Python HTTPS failed certificate validation. No verification bypass was used. Method details remain inherited K1 evidence, **not freshly confirmed**. Direct SW supply, current method, pricing, SLA, redistribution and derived-use permissions need owner/provider confirmation; no direct API contract or license was established. |
| Alternative provider/product: Shenzhen Securities Information / CNINDEX | [Official services page](https://www.cnindex.com.cn/zh_services/data_licensing/index.html?act_menu=4&act_service=3) offers corporate data agreements and authorized agents, index PE/fundamentals, sample/classification/free-share data and industry static PE. It separately describes outward index-display authorization. Published contact: `szsi_index.service@szse.cn`, 0755-83202239. | This is a procurement alternative for a separately designed product, **not** a drop-in SW2021 comparator, SW PB source or proof of equivalent financial basis. A switch requires explicit taxonomy/metric/method/version decisions and new validation, plus contractual scope. |
| Alternative raw exchange inputs / independent evidence | [SSE official service directory](https://www.sse.com.cn/transparency/services/) routes market-data product/authorization inquiries through SSE Information and its business platform; contact `marketservice@sse.com.cn`. | Investigate independent prices/share evidence and permitted derived use. It does not by itself supply SW classifications/official PE/PB, settle cross-class share treatment or satisfy the golden set. No golden values were transcribed here. |

The rights evidence changes the precision of the procurement question: ask for a written grant matching the actual internal and public uses, rather than asking only whether 5000 points or a public web page is available. No inference is made about existing private contracts, which were not inspected. No legal rights conclusion or license status change is made.

## Exact owner decisions still required

1. **H / methodology:** choose (a) a separately identified `pe_ttm_sw` validation effort with existing whole-company PE kept distinct, or (b) retain whole-company PE with all official PE comparisons `not_applicable` and no publication under current U5. A third route—another provider/benchmark—is a new specification, not a silent substitution. Record signer/date, metric identity, formula, financial reporting calendar, version/hash and comparator mapping before implementation. Neither shared “TTM” naming nor a near numerical fit approves comparability.
2. **H / candidate inputs and edge cases:** if (a), determine exact SW versus Tushare free-share source, A/H/B denominator treatment, TTM cutoff/version consistency, missing inputs, negative profits, numerator retention versus exclusion, suspension/delisting, IPO admission and minimum sample handling. K1's two-industry/five-day exploration conflicts with the 2012 loss-exclusion description and uses a proxy; confirm current provider methodology or explicitly approve a separately named method. No thresholds are changed here.
3. **PB owner:** either keep PB ineligible (current state), or commission current-method verification and approve a distinct PB specification. Resolve parent equity versus other-equity adjustments, negative equity, weighting and reporting cutoffs against primary provider evidence and independent assertions. Do not borrow Tushare `daily_basic.pb` semantics for `sw_daily.pb` or inherit PE qualification.
4. **A / rights owner:** separately determine scheme, marks and official permissions; all three remain internal. Options are a documented grant for the existing supply chain, a documented direct/provider alternative with new adapter scope, or continued disabled/public-unavailable valuation. Record entity, covered datasets/versions, purpose, users, storage/retention, derivation, display/replay/redistribution, attribution, territory/term and upstream permissions. Official-value replay permission does not authorize derived valuation publication. Internal database status is not proof that organizational use is permitted by a contract.
5. **C / availability and operations:** actual 5000-point/API entitlement, historic marks/SW coverage, provider revisions, rate/backfill limits, complete calendar plus specified monthly/weekly sampling boundaries and storage/retention budget. Published limits are documentation, not a successful live account probe. Separate raw acquisition rights from derived-output rights.
6. **Evidence owner:** produce the specified exchange golden set (5 companies including A+H ×2 days; 3 industries ×4 official PE/PB dates) with independent original evidence. Expand current-method experiments across reporting-calendar transitions, loss-heavy industries, A+H/A+B, missing/free shares, new stocks and suspensions. Synthetic tests and inherited ten-cell exploration are not golden acceptance.
7. **Integration owner, after H/rights:** validate ≥24 valid pairs **per code/metric**, ≥90% paired expected dates, ≥95% of numeric pairs within exact 1%; use complete approved calendar and current official revisions even on carry dates. Exercise real PostgreSQL stage/publish/activate, dependencies, version incompatibility/full recompute, current-observation races, immutable manifests and replay. Do not pool series or use rounded `rel_diff` for classification.
8. **E / CN readiness and Q2 / judgment owners:** independent CN real-facts acceptance, worker/readiness and judgment method/resolution/settlement decisions remain required. Production scheduling and public activation require their existing gates. This work does not assert these dependencies passed.

## Verification

- Installed lockfile dependencies locally under the assigned checkout: `env PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/node@22/bin:$PATH npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` (exit 0). Explicit Node executable reports **v22.22.1**; the initial login-shell `node` resolved to v26.5.0, so all npm verification used the Node22 path explicitly.

Accepted: run delivered preparation/diagnostic/disabled-route/input tests, and explicitly exclude claims about SQL-side #154, live provider, rights and real I-3 acceptance. The selected run includes all four core suites and the proposed regression surfaces.

The reviewer overlooked existing exact 90% (27/30) and 95% (38/40) cases, which were supplied in its context; those are not gaps.
